RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel gender composition alone is not evidence of discrimination; selection panels typically reflect available departmental leaders rather than demographic intent. Furthermore, modern public broadcasters frequently prioritize digital media expertise over traditional tenure, providing a legitimate, objective rationale for selecting the other candidate. 

Accusing the panel of bias without concrete evidence—such as documented procedural irregularities or biased remarks—is legally unsubstantiated and carries significant risk to your professional reputation and working relationships. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up request regarding your written feedback. Frame your inquiry around constructive professional development to understand how the criteria were weighted and which specific competencies tipped the balance.
